shots.detail_en: CH tilts his head back and closes his eyes one second before the opening bell, his own reflection in the unlit board glass.
shots.sub: 他们要收货——那就让他们知道，货架前站了人。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The opening bell rings and the Lianhua Hotel line keeps plunging, green light washing over the packed hall.
shots.sub: 恐慌第二轮——比第一轮更整齐。
shots.speaker: VO

shots.detail_en: MANCANG takes a deep breath and dives into the most panicked corner of the crowd.
shots.sub: 都别慌！天塌不下来——真塌了，我垫！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: MANCANG stands on a bench and spreads his arms wide like an overweight orchestra conductor.
shots.sub: 深呼吸！跟我念——慌，就输了；不慌，也未必赢，但起码——体面！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: RED circles the one-order-per-minute rhythm on the flow sheet behind the counter, the rhythm still ticking.
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH and RED trade a hand signal across the crowd—two fingers pressed together, the rhythm unbroken.
The board's price and volume turn into an ECG line in CH's eyes, its peaks suspiciously even.
shots.sub: 有节奏的东西，都会在节奏里露馅。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CH, RED and MANCANG land a four-hit montage: the steadied crowd, ledger pages flipping, CH's pupils, RED's red pen tip.
shots.sub: 恐慌是我们唯一的武器库——它把对手的节奏，全摆上了台面。
shots.speaker: VO

shots.detail_en: RED's pen tip halts sharply—the one-order-per-minute rhythm suddenly stops.
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH watches the suspended green board and lifts the corner of his mouth.
shots.sub: 采购员发现——货架前站了人。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CH presses the corner of his father's notebook against his chest through his shirt and looks up.
A red pillar shoots up on the big board, the green sea flips red, and the hall explodes.
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: MANCANG spins around a pillar hugging it, his flower shirt flaring like a bloom.
shots.sub: 小胜！小胜也是胜！我全仓我膨胀——但绝不追加！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: At the closing bell CH, RED and MANCANG high-five in the empty hall, the mop standing before the board like a fourth member.
shots.sub: 同盟首战战绩——活着，还赢了！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: RED waves the flow sheet at CH in the after-hours light.
shots.sub: 同一只手，今天收回去了。／收回手之前——它先记住了我们的脸。
shots.speaker: RED+CH

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI stands with his back to camera in the machine room atop Lianhua Tower before a full wall of cold data.
shots.sub: 今日大厅情绪曲线，偏离模型基线——百分之七。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: CH, RED and MANCANG's faces are boxed one by one on the data wall by algorithm frame lines.
A tolerance-zone chart pops up as the victory red-pillar curve lands squarely inside the green safety band.
shots.sub: 所有胜利都有价格。他们的价格——是被采样。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI sips from his thermos cup as the screen freezes the victory curve inside a red specimen frame.
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: XIONG stands unnoticed in the machine-room doorway, rolling his prayer beads while watching the data wall.
shots.sub: 让年轻人先赢两把。牌桌上——先数筹码的人，先输筹码。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: XIONG gazes toward the trading hall, his smile merciful and his eyes cold.
shots.sub: 我从来没有做错任何事——让，也是一种对。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Black end card with next-episode caption.
shots.sub: 他们赢下的第一仗，从头到尾——都活在别人的屏幕里。
shots.speaker: VO
shots.card: 他们赢下的第一仗，从头到尾——都活在别人的屏幕里。
